why: Main picture is a smiling courtesy-call photo of Governor Arlekar handing a bouquet to Vice-President Radhakrishnan (November 6, before the killings). On a story about Deepavali murders, including a police officer, this breaks the tone rule, and the Vice-President has nothing to do with the story. The hero brief asked for Amit Shah and Vijay. Also, the Hindi alt spells the name 'आर्लेकर' while the Hindi title and body use 'अर्लेकर'.
